title: Artificial Hivemind: The Open-Ended Homogeneity of Language Models (and Beyond)
reasoning: The paper introduces the INFINITY-CHAT dataset and a corresponding taxonomy of open-ended queries that includes specific categories for 'Philosophical Questions', 'Value-Laden Questions', and 'Controversial Questions'. It explicitly studies how models handle topics such as free speech, morality, and religious perspectives (e.g., discipleship) and benchmarks the distribution of human preferences across these ethically and morally nuanced queries.
